blocks.text: INDIAN WELLS, California — Elina Svitolina is ready to call it a year. Carrying the emotional weight of playing top-level tennis while her home country of Ukraine is at war and navigating a public split with her husband at the same time they co-parent their child has taken a toll. Svitolina made it back to the season-ending WTA Finals after a seven-year absence despite her personal turmoil. She lost to Mirra Andreeva 7-5, 6-3 in the title match on Sunday.
